name: American Cancer Society
story: $1,000 funds cancer research, tobacco-tax and coverage campaigns and screening drives, and every **{patient-services: cost_total / households_reached|$}** helps one household facing cancer with lodging, rides and advice.
summary: The largest US cancer charity: funds cancer research and runs its own population and statistics research, campaigns on tobacco, insurance coverage and research funding through its advocacy affiliate ACS CAN, promotes screening and prevention, and gives patients free lodging at Hope Lodge communities, volunteer rides to treatment and a 24/7 helpline.

spending.source: https://www.cancer.org/content/dam/cancer-org/online-documents/en/pdf/policies/combined-financials-2026.pdf (Consolidated Financial Statements, year ended March 31, 2026, p. 7: total mission program services $674,811 thousand: patient support $426,454k, research $193,291k, advocacy $55,066k; of total expenses $830,207k, excluding management and general $37,228k and fundraising $118,168k. ACS moved its year end from December to March in 2025; the year is labelled 2025, the calendar year most of it falls in.)

lines.label: Research, advocacy (ACS CAN) and prevention and screening promotion
lines.source: https://www.cancer.org/content/dam/cancer-org/online-documents/en/pdf/policies/combined-financials-2026.pdf (p. 7): research $193,291k plus advocacy $55,066k plus the prevention and early-detection part of patient support, our judgment of 45% of $426,454k (facts: american_cancer_society.prevention_share_of_support) = $440,261,300, year to March 31, 2026.

lines.label: Hope Lodge lodging, Road To Recovery rides, the helpline and information
lines.source: https://www.cancer.org/content/dam/cancer-org/online-documents/en/pdf/policies/combined-financials-2026.pdf (p. 7): patient support $426,454k less the prevention and early-detection share (45%, a judgment) = $234,549,700, year to March 31, 2026.
